name: Warbit Cowl
description: Feet set shoulder-width and the haft held across the body, so the braced frame takes a push without giving ground.

name: Battledrop
description: Both hands bring the axe head down from above the brow in a straight line onto the target.

name: Level Banded
description: A level swing at knee height bites the bit into the legs of an advancing opponent.

name: Fouling Wideeye
description: The blunt poll raps a raised weapon hand, jarring the grip and spoiling the opponent's next cut.

name: Warbitpause
description: The haft is raised level in both hands to catch and turn a descending blade aside.

name: Easing Warcleave
description: One foot pivots rearward as the axe is drawn in, opening distance after a swing.

name: Warbitdash
description: A full swing lands the bit on the same mark of a standing log, training accurate placement of the edge.

name: Descending Brunt
description: The head follows the line of the target's guard arm downward, splitting its cover with the edge.

name: Open Battleheel
description: Two cuts follow in rhythm, the second landing as the first is recovered, to keep an opponent covering.

name: Solid Haftcap
description: After a cut the rear heel drops and the haft returns across the chest to cover the body.

name: Smitepause
description: The haft rolls in the hands to lift the head clear of a grab and break the opponent's hold.

name: Quiet Warpoll
description: A short gliding step closes the gap just as the cut is released.

name: Soft Crescentbit
description: The bit is turned to face the opponent's line, letting the user read distance from the edge's reach.

name: Smitehit
description: A wide diagonal swing from shoulder to hip drives the bit through the opponent's near side.

name: Warbitbump
description: A short angled chop cuts a notch into the target's guard, weakening it for the next blow.

name: Short Warbeard
description: The head swings back past the shoulder and returns in a second cut without a pause.

name: Solid Warhelve
description: The haft is braced against the forearm to catch a strike and turn its force sideways.

name: Battleheel Husk
description: The back foot digs in as if against a stump, holding the user upright under a shove.

name: Smite Drop
description: Both hands slide up behind the head for a short, quick chop at close range.

name: Short Bitedge
description: Hands at the haft's far end give the swing its full reach, and the bit strikes beyond the opponent's guard.

name: Stiff Warcleave
description: The lead hand slides down the haft mid-swing, lengthening the stroke into a surprise cut.

name: Hard Rive
description: The haft's butt-end jabs forward into the ribs while the head is held back.

name: Banded Pause
description: The axe is held at its point of balance across the body, a still guard that is easy to turn either way.

name: Planted Haftcap
description: A rising haft catches a cut and rolls it off the wood to one side.

name: Pushing Crescentbit
description: The hands swap their positions on the haft, reversing the axe's direction and confusing the opponent's reading of the cut.

name: Mild Warbeard
description: A slow lift of the axe lets the user feel its weight and judge how much swing it will carry.

name: Rivebump
description: The hips turn first and the shoulders follow, sending the bit through the target with the whole body behind it.

name: Bitedge Drop
description: A sliding step brings the user inside the opponent's reach and the edge lands as the step ends.

name: Nimble Battercut
description: Two uneven backward steps pull the user out of reach while the axe stays raised to cover.

name: Backward Brunt
description: A slow circling walk keeps the opponent on the head side of the axe and the user outside the thrust.

name: Battlecowl
description: One foot is set hard behind the other and the haft is raised, stopping a rush without a backward step.

name: Settled Warpoll
description: After a missed swing the weight shifts back and the haft sweeps up to turn an incoming blow.

name: Descending Hewdown
description: The axe rises and drops in one vertical line, putting the bit through anything in its path.

name: Descending Warhelve
description: A rising cut from low guard turns over at the top and finishes as a downward chop.

name: Warbit Strike
description: A flat horizontal cut at shoulder height sweeps across the opponent's upper body.

name: Firm Smite
description: The user chops once and pulls the head free at once, so the axe is never trapped.

name: Battlehusk
description: The haft rises quickly under a blow and the edge turns it away from the user's head.

name: Settled Haftcap
description: The axe is held flat above the brow, covering the head and shoulders from a downward cut.

name: Rivepace
description: Two short steps to either side of the opponent's line set up and finish a cleave.

name: Warbit Gauge
description: Qi is drawn along the haft with each breath, giving the bit a little more weight in the swing.

name: Open Warpoll
description: A chop in which qi gathers at the edge for a moment, cutting deeper than the arm alone.

name: Battlelid
description: Qi held in the arms and haft stiffens the guard, so the axe resists a hard blow without trembling.

name: Short Rive
description: The user breathes out as the bit falls, letting the qi and the cut finish at the same moment.

name: Rivehop
description: An in-breath times a backward step and a drawing-in of the axe to reset the guard.

name: Catching Battleheel
description: A brief pulse of qi in the edge rings against an enemy blade and shakes the opponent's grip.

name: Narrow Battercut
description: Qi lies along the edge in a thin film, helping the bit bite through leather and light mail.

name: Downward Hewdown
description: A downward cut with qi in the head carries through a raised guard and strikes the shoulder.

name: Battlestrike
description: Qi held at the edge lets the axe rebound from a block into a second chop.

name: Warbeard Wedge
description: Qi wraps the haft during a parry, so a blade glances off instead of biting the wood.

name: Smitedodge
description: A skimming step carries the user to the side as the thin edge cuts across the target.

name: Battlenote
description: At the top of a lifted swing qi sinks into the head, making the coming cut heavy.

name: Battlehit
description: The qi-heavy head drops from the top of the swing and carries its weight into the target.

name: Wide Brunt
description: The weighted axe turns at the hip in a wide flat cut that is hard to stop.

name: Holding Bitedge
description: The user braces behind a settled axe, using its weight and a held breath to resist a heavy blow.

name: Banded Wedge
description: The qi weight is let out of the head and the axe flicks up fast to turn a quick thrust.

name: Riveskitter
description: A sinking step plants the user as the weighted head falls, so the blow is not thrown off balance.

name: Pulling Hewdown
description: A short snap of the weighted head against an opponent's wrist knocks a weapon off its line.

name: Kind Wideeye
description: Qi runs from the palms down the haft and gathers in the head for the next cut.

name: Bandeddrop
description: A chop carried by qi flowing down the haft strikes harder than the swing alone would.

name: Straight Smite
description: Two small pulses of qi down the haft give a pair of cuts the same weight.

name: Warbitwedge
description: Qi along the haft stiffens it like a spine, and the axe stops a heavy cut across the body.

name: Planted Crescentbit
description: A pulse of qi through the haft knocks aside a blade with a short sharp flick.

name: Stiff Warhelve
description: The axe leads a lunging step, its qi line reaching a hand's breadth beyond the edge.

name: Shifting Banded
description: A smooth sliding step follows the haft's qi line, moving the user lightly into the opponent's flank.

name: Warm Haftcap
description: Qi held in the palms reads the haft's hum, telling the user when a blade has landed on the edge.

name: Hitching Rive
description: The beard of the head catches a limb or shield rim and draws it toward the user.

name: Turning Hewdown
description: The beard hooks over a shield's rim and drags it down, exposing the bearer's chest.

name: Catching Battercut
description: The beard hooks the opponent's ankle in a low sweep and tips him off his feet.

name: Battleblow
description: After hooking, the user pulls the opponent in and chops with the bit.

name: Hooding Warbit
description: The hooked beard catches an incoming blade and wrenches it to the side.

name: Sideways Wideeye
description: With the beard set on a target, a quick step in follows the pull and closes the distance.

name: Bruntdrop
description: Cuts are thrown on a steady four-count of breath, each landing at the same depth and angle.

name: Descending Battercut
description: A single long exhale carries qi and the axe through one very deep cleave.

name: Bitedge Cowl
description: The user holds the guard to the rhythm of breath and spends almost no qi while holding it.

name: Battlewedge
description: A caught breath times a short upward flick of the haft, turning a cut aside.

name: Easing Crescentbit
description: Steps matched to breath let the user circle a long time without tiring.

name: Bandedgauge
description: Counting the opponent's breaths shows when the next attack is coming.

name: Deep Warbeard
description: A slow breath between exchanges returns qi to the arms and sets the grip again.
